articles.title: Trump Rolls Back Fuel Economy Standards as Gas Prices Rise
articles.summary: The Trump administration reversed Biden-era fuel rules, dropping the 2031 average from over 50 mpg to 34.9 mpg. The government says it cuts car costs by about $1,300, but drivers may pay more at the pump.

articles.title: ShinyHunters Says It Won't Leak FBI Data — But Can't Control What Happens Next
articles.summary: A hacking group called ShinyHunters says it stole private data from thousands of FBI employees. Now it says it won't publish the data, but it already shared samples with journalists and can't promise they stay secret.

articles.title: SpaceX's Starship Reaches Orbit for the First Time
articles.summary: SpaceX's Starship rocket launched from Texas on Monday and reached orbit for the first time, deploying 26 Starlink satellites. An engine failed during ascent, so the flight was shortened to three hours.
